slides.title: Partners often rate their own brand [too highly].
slides.lede: Fifteen questions, about five minutes. Answer for the firm as it is today, not as you'd like it to be.

slides.title: What decides [value or price]
slides.note: Three questions in each area, each scored from **the weakest position to the strongest**.

slides.title: How often do fee conversations [turn into justification]?
slides.text: When the brand signals status, rates defend themselves. When it doesn't, partners spend chargeable hours defending them.

slides.title: What level of firm [do you look like]?

cards.label: Weakest answer
cards.text: Smaller and cheaper than we really are.

cards.label: Strongest answer
cards.text: In line with the leading firms in our sector.

slides.title: Ask an AI assistant to [recommend a firm like yours]
